amendment_A1.status_at_amendment: PRE-EXECUTION: no dev or confirmatory training had run under this manifest (chain-validation smokes only, ep-stamped 30, excluded by the sentinel stamp); amendment therefore precedes all data.

amendment_A2.what: ALL 10 SIGNAL arms gain agent.s_init=75 (was yaml default 5).
amendment_A2.why: DEFECT FOUND PRE-DATA by a full-budget local dev run. conf/agent/signal.yaml sets s_init=5 with the documented rationale 'small; d_hat now supplies the demand-scaled level' -- i.e. the base-stock head's level came from dhat_coef(5) x dhat_init(14) = 70 via the d_head path. A18 sets use_dhat_head=false on every v3 arm (correctly: that path is the captured-forecast defect), which removed the level term and left S_init ~ 7.8. With inventory position ~44, order = clip(S-IP,0,100) = 0: agents order NOTHING from step one, the chain starves, episode cost sits at ~18,000 vs the ~3,750 AR_CondBS frontier, critic explained_variance ~ 0, and PPO must climb the head bias from 5 to ~70 by gradient descent (observed: raw best 17,830 @ ep3400 then EARLY STOP; dhatc best 18,211 @ ep600 then EARLY STOP).
amendment_A2.value_rationale: s_init=75 reproduces the PILOT's effective initialization exactly: v2 arms ran use_dhat_head=true, giving head bias s_init(5) + dhat_coef(5) x dhat_init(14) = 75 => S_init ~ 74. This is instrument continuity, not a new tuning choice: the registered v2.1 campaign that produced SIGNAL-raw = 3745.8 started from this level.
amendment_A2.status_at_amendment: PRE-EXECUTION for the confirmatory campaign: no seed in 70-94 has produced data under this manifest. Local dev-seed (60) runs that exposed the defect are diagnostic, disclosed, and discarded.
amendment_A2.scope: SIGNAL arms only. QMIX selects S from a fixed discrete grid (41 levels, s_max 160) and never had a head-bias init, so the QMIX program is unaffected.

amendment_A3.what: SUPERSEDES A2. All 10 SIGNAL arms: use_dhat_head=TRUE, s_init back to the yaml default 5, and the dhatc arm keeps forecast_mode=separate_frozen (A19 CONTINUITY MODE, enabled in code v3.2; T12b asserts acceptance, T12 still fail-closes raw+frozen and typo modes).
amendment_A3.why:
Full-budget dev-seed measurement at rho=0.9 (seed 60, identical protocol) showed the v3.0 A18 design does not reproduce the registered pilot:
  A18 clean (no d_hat in S head): nocomm 4965.3 raw 5062.6 V=-97   (+35% vs frontier)
  d_hat in S head, DETACHED     : nocomm 4875.2 raw 4833.8 V=+41   (no learning; both arms best@ep200, early stop ep2200)
  d_hat in S head WITH gradient : nocomm 4788.6 raw 3976.1 V=+813  (+6.1% vs frontier)
  registered pilot (n=25)       : nocomm 4207.8 raw 3745.8 V=+462
Diagnosis: the critic explains ~0 variance, so the low-dimensional policy gradient through the d_hat scalar is the learner's PRINCIPAL channel for adapting the order-up-to level. A18 and the detach variant both sever it, leaving a static base-stock frozen near initialization and V ~ 0 BY CONSTRUCTION (identical frozen actuation across arms leaves nothing for a message to change).
amendment_A3.reframing_of_the_defect: The internal d_hat is a POLICY PARAMETERIZATION (a learned level scalar), not a forecast -- which is exactly why the audit found pred SD 0.50 vs bench 5.52. The defect was therefore never in the actuation; it was BROADCASTING that internal scalar as if it were a demand forecast. The repair belongs in the MESSAGE: msg_content=dhat + forecast_mode=separate_frozen now broadcasts the CERTIFIED FROZEN forecast (ratio 1.047, bias -0.018, SD 5.616/5.625) while the policy retains its internal scalar. Contribution C3 (pretrain->certify->freeze) is unchanged and arguably strengthened: the mechanism is demonstrated and repaired at its true site rather than amputated.
amendment_A3.design_gain: Actuation is now IDENTICAL across all arms (every arm carries the same internal level scalar), so message content is the only manipulated variable -- a cleaner control than the pilot had.
amendment_A3.status_at_amendment: PRE-EXECUTION: no seed in 70-94 has produced data. Dev-seed (60) diagnostics are disclosed and discarded.

amendment_A4.why: msg_head conditioning: mid-episode |tanh| 0.06-0.40 (mute) -> 0.395-0.624 (responsive). Mechanistic, not V-selected; V gain +45 is inside seed noise. entropy_coef/lr/k_epochs/gae_lambda/reward_scale all KEPT at registered values: no sweep setting beat baseline beyond noise.
